<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 6"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Volcanic Escape](/Feats.aspx?ID=4243) <actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=72" />
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Overflow" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=506" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 28

**Trigger**
An enemy in your kinetic aura damages you.

</column>

---

Lava reflexively explodes underneath you and the creature that hurt you. The triggering enemy takes 1d6 fire damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save against your class DC. You [Leap](/Actions.aspx?ID=81) up to half your Speed in any direction; this movement doesn't trigger reactions.

---
**Level (+4)** The damage increases by 1d6.
name: Volcanic Escape
